description: Every ERROR and WARN entry that a complete runGameTestServer log is expected to contain. Each expectation records a deliberate refusal or failure path that a named GameTest drives, or a bounded environment warning. scripts/check_gametest_log.py fails on any FATAL entry, any entry not listed here and any count that differs.

expectations.message: ARCE_FORCE_FIELD_POWER_REFUSED projector=[0-9a-f-]{36} pos=-?\d+, -?\d+, -?\d+ failure=IllegalStateException
expectations.reason: The test reports one deliberate power callback failure and verifies that repeated failures on the same projector do not emit another diagnostic or mutate persisted data.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RECOVERY transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} phase=PREPARED source_count=1 destination_count=0 action=KEEP_SOURCE status=WAITING_FOR_PASSENGERS
expectations.reason: Three native entity/player/journal round trips each recover through both the installed lifecycle owner and a fresh manager with an offline passenger, deliberately retaining PREPARED source authority and refusing resource mutations.

expectations.message: Exception caught during firing event: Refusing chunk save with oversized recipe input; back up and repair first
expectations.reason: The tests post chunk-save events whose machines hold oversized recipe input; the guard must refuse each save by throwing, and Forge's event bus logs every thrown listener exception at ERROR.

expectations.message: Exception caught during firing event: Refusing chunk save with oversized combustion input; back up and repair first
expectations.reason: An oversized combustion input must refuse the chunk save before the stored root is replaced.

expectations.message: Exception caught during firing event: Refusing chunk save with non-admissible solar input; back up and repair first
expectations.reason: A non-admissible solar reference must refuse the whole outgoing chunk save.

expectations.message: Channels \[advancedrocketrycommunity:machine_menu\] rejected their server side version number
expectations.reason: The test offers mismatched machine-menu channel versions; Forge logs each rejected server-side version at ERROR.

expectations.message: Channels \[advancedrocketrycommunity:machine_menu\] rejected their client side version number
expectations.reason: The test offers mismatched machine-menu channel versions; Forge logs each rejected client-side version at ERROR.

expectations.message: Exception caught during firing event: Intentional one-shot Precision migration save failure
expectations.reason: The tests inject one failed chunk save during Precision Assembler migration to prove the migration is not marked durable.

expectations.message: Exception caught during firing event: Intentional Energy-only migration binding save failure
expectations.reason: The tests inject failed chunk saves during the Energy-only binding migration to prove retry and gating.

expectations.message: Failed to save chunk -?\d+,-?\d+
expectations.exception: java\.lang\.IllegalStateException: Intentional Energy-only migration binding save failure
expectations.reason: Vanilla reports the binding fixture's injected save failure with its exact throwable and failure-handler frame.

expectations.message: Failed to save chunk -?\d+,-?\d+
expectations.exception: java\.lang\.IllegalStateException: Intentional one-shot Precision migration save failure
expectations.reason: Vanilla reports the one-shot fixture's injected save failure with its exact throwable and failure-handler frame.

expectations.message: Precision Assembler migration port marker roots are not confirmed on disk at BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\} in minecraft:overworld: BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\}: arce_precision_port_migration differs \(expected hash=-?\d+, saved hash=-?\d+\)
expectations.reason: After an injected save failure the migration must report that its port markers are not confirmed on disk.

expectations.message: Precision Assembler migration port marker roots are not confirmed on disk at BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\} in minecraft:overworld: BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\}: arce_part_binding differs \(expected hash=-?\d+, saved hash=-?\d+\)
expectations.reason: The Energy-only gate reports the binding root mismatch, not the other fixture's migration marker root.

expectations.message: Precision Assembler migration controller snapshot roots are not confirmed on disk at BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\} in minecraft:overworld: BlockPos\{x=-?\d+, y=-?\d+, z=-?\d+\}: arce_precision_resources differs \(expected hash=-?\d+, saved hash=-?\d+\)
expectations.reason: After an injected save failure the migration must report that its controller snapshot is not confirmed on disk.

expectations.message: Satellite idle launch operation failed
expectations.reason: The tests make the satellite registry flush fail or block it; the launch must fail closed and keep the package.

expectations.message: Satellite launch operation failed
expectations.reason: The test makes the launch acknowledgment flush fail to prove the paid receipt recovers without a second claim.

expectations.message: Disabling machine recipe advancedrocketrycommunity:rolling_iron_bars until tag reload: machine ingredient has no bound alternatives
expectations.reason: The rolling recipe must independently be disabled until tags reload; another recipe cannot replace its log entry.

expectations.message: Disabling machine recipe advancedrocketrycommunity:precision_control_circuit until tag reload: machine ingredient has no bound alternatives
expectations.reason: The precision recipe must independently be disabled until tags reload.

expectations.message: Disabling machine recipe advancedrocketrycommunity:electrolyzer_water until tag reload: machine ingredient has no bound alternatives
expectations.reason: The electrolyzer recipe must independently be disabled until tags reload.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RETURNED_TO_SOURCE transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} logical=[0-9a-f-]{36} reason=destination_pad_blocked fuel=\d+
expectations.reason: Each test blocks the destination pad and requires the rocket to return to its source.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RECOVERY transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} phase=PREPARED source_count=1 destination_count=0 action=KEEP_SOURCE status=RECOVERED
expectations.reason: The source-only prepared transfer must keep its source; counts cannot substitute another recovery case.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RECOVERY transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} phase=PREPARED source_count=0 destination_count=1 action=KEEP_DESTINATION status=RECOVERED
expectations.reason: The destination-only prepared transfer must keep its destination.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RECOVERY transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} phase=PREPARED source_count=1 destination_count=1 action=REMOVE_DESTINATION_KEEP_SOURCE status=RECOVERED
expectations.reason: The prepared duplicate transfer must remove its destination and keep its source.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_RECOVERY transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} phase=DESTINATION_SPAWNED source_count=0 destination_count=0 action=REBUILD_DESTINATION status=RECOVERED
expectations.reason: The destination-spawned transfer with neither entity must rebuild its destination.

expectations.message: ARCE_TRANSFER_LOGIN_RECONCILED transfer=[0-9a-f-]{36} logical=[0-9a-f-]{36} authority=[0-9a-f-]{36} removed=\d+
expectations.reason: A legacy passenger logs in after an interrupted transfer and must be reconciled.

expectations.message: ARCE_STATION_ACCESS_DENIED player=[0-9a-f-]{36} position=-?\d+, -?\d+, -?\d+ dimension=advancedrocketrycommunity:space authority_available=(true|false)
expectations.reason: The tests act on a station as players without permission, or while station authority is unavailable, and require denial.

expectations.message: ARCE_STATION_DELETE_BACKUP station=[0-9a-f-]{36} owner=[0-9a-f-]{36} members=\[.*\] cell=-?\d+,-?\d+ region=-?\d+,-?\d+,-?\d+,-?\d+
expectations.reason: Deleting a station records its backup before removal.

expectations.message: ARCE_STATION_DELETED station=[0-9a-f-]{36} actor=[0-9a-f-]{36} inspected=\d+ removed=\d+ chunks=\d+
expectations.reason: Deleting a station records the actor and the removed blocks.

expectations.message: ARCE_STATION_WARP_ENERGY_DROPPED station=[0-9a-f-]{36} energy=\d+
expectations.reason: Each test ends or aborts a charged warp, and the station must record the warp energy it drops.

expectations.message: ARCE_SATELLITE_RECEIVER_RELEASE_SKIPPED receiver=[0-9a-f-]{36} reason=registry_blocked
expectations.reason: With the satellite registry blocked, releasing a receiver must be skipped rather than crash.

expectations.message: ARCE_SATELLITE_RESTORE quarantined_missions=\d+ recovery_required=\d+ quarantined_instances=\d+ accounts_added=\d+
expectations.reason: Restoring a satellite registry with an invalid mission must quarantine it and report recovery.

expectations.message: Suit oxygen provider fixture:suit disabled for this server session: update contract failure
expectations.reason: A fixture suit provider breaks its update contract and must be disabled for the session.

expectations.message: Rocket adapter arce_adapter_test:cargo_inventory exceeded returned-time budget in restore
expectations.reason: The fixture adapter sleeps past the 5 ms callback budget in restore and must be rejected once with a warning.

expectations.message: Incorrect key (?!machines\.sawmillVanillaWood\b|forceField(?:\.enabled)? was|(?:OXYGEN|ROCKET)(?:\s|\.)|equipment\.(?:jetPackForce|lowGravityBoots)\s)[\w.]+ was corrected from null to its default, .*
expectations.test: environment: configuration files created by the run
expectations.reason: Forge fills each key missing from a newly created configuration file; a run that reuses existing files logs fewer. A key corrected from a non-null value does not match.

expectations.message: Incorrect key machines\.sawmillVanillaWood was corrected from null to its default, true\.
expectations.test: environment: W05 COMMON sawmill setting on first GameTest startup
expectations.reason: W05 adds this default-on COMMON key. Forge emits this exact warning once when the key is absent and none when the configuration is reused. The unrelated config-key budget remains 99; false defaults, non-null corrections, repeated entries and messages outside startup are not admitted.

expectations.message: Incorrect key forceField was corrected from null to its default, SimpleCommentedConfig:\{\}.
expectations.reason: Forge creates the single forceField group when this slice's server configuration is absent.

expectations.message: Incorrect key forceField\.enabled was corrected from null to its default, true\.
expectations.reason: Forge creates the one enabled switch at its declared true default; non-null corrections are not allowed.

expectations.message: Configuration file .+[\\/]advancedrocketrycommunity-force-field\.toml is not correct\. Correcting
expectations.reason: Forge reports creation of this slice's server configuration once; the existing configuration-file allowance remains unchanged.

expectations.message: Incorrect key OXYGEN was corrected from null to its default, SimpleCommentedConfig:\{\}\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W03 equipment configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The new finite equipment OXYGEN section is defaulted once on a new config, independently of the unchanged legacy key warning budget.

expectations.message: Incorrect key OXYGEN\.suitTankCapacity was corrected from null to its default, 1\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W03 equipment configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The tank creation multiplier defaults to 1 once on a new config. Non-null corrections and other values do not match.

expectations.message: Incorrect key OXYGEN\.scrubberRequiresCartrige was corrected from null to its default, true\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W14 life-support configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The cartridge requirement defaults to true exactly once; the OXYGEN section is already excluded from the generic 99-warning budget.

expectations.message: Incorrect key OXYGEN\.oxygenDetection was corrected from null to its default, true\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W14 life-support configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The detector switch defaults to true exactly once; the OXYGEN section is already excluded from the generic 99-warning budget.

expectations.message: Incorrect key OXYGEN\.spaceSuitO2Buffer was corrected from null to its default, 2000\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W03 equipment configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The finite active oxygen target defaults to 2000 once on a new config. Non-null corrections and other values do not match.

expectations.message: Incorrect key ROCKET(?:\.(?:thrustMultiplier|fuelCapacityMultiplier|nuclearCoreThrustRatio|gravityAffectsFuels|rocketsRequireFuel|canBeFueledByHand|rocketFuels|rocketBipropellants|rocketOxidizers|rocketNuclearWorkingFluids))? was corrected from null to its default, .*
expectations.test: environment: W02 propulsion configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The ADR-065 C17a ROCKET section and its ten values are each defaulted once on a new config, independently of the unchanged legacy key warning budget. Other ROCKET keys and non-null corrections do not match.

expectations.message: Incorrect key equipment\.jetPackForce was corrected from null to its default, 1\.3\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W06 equipment configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The jetpack force defaults to 1.3 once on a new config, independently of the unchanged legacy key warning budget. Non-null corrections and other values do not match.

expectations.message: Incorrect key equipment\.lowGravityBoots was corrected from null to its default, false\.\s*
expectations.test: environment: W06 equipment configuration created by the run
expectations.reason: The landing-boots rule defaults to false once on a new config, independently of the unchanged legacy key warning budget. Non-null corrections and other values do not match.

expectations.message: Configuration file .+[\\/](forge-server|advancedrocketrycommunity-common)\.toml is not correct\. Correcting
expectations.test: environment: configuration files created by the run
expectations.reason: Forge reports once per newly created configuration file before filling its keys.

expectations.message: Configuration file .+[\\/]fml\.toml is not correct\. Correcting
expectations.test: environment: configuration files created by the run
expectations.reason: FML reports once when it creates its own configuration file.

expectations.message: Mod file .+[\\/](fmlcore|javafmllanguage|lowcodelanguage|mclanguage)-1\.20\.1-47\.4\.\d+\.jar is missing mods\.toml file
expectations.reason: The Forge userdev launch scans its own four language and core jars, which have no mods.toml.

expectations.message: Assets URL 'union:.+' uses unexpected schema
expectations.reason: Under userdev the vanilla assets root is a union file system URL, which vanilla does not recognise.

expectations.message: Reference map 'advancedrocketrycommunity\.refmap\.json' for advancedrocketrycommunity\.mixins\.json could not be read\. If this is a development environment you can ignore this message
expectations.reason: Under userdev the game runs with official names, so the ADR-073 Mixin needs no refmap and Mixin notes that the generated refmap is not on the run classpath. The packaged jar carries the refmap; MixinPackagingTest checks it. Any other Mixin warning does not match.

expectations.message: Can't keep up! Is the server overloaded\? Running \d+ms or \d+ ticks behind
expectations.reason: Recognizes at most five vanilla host-lag notices; complete retained runs logged one each. This count is a diagnostic ceiling, not a duration, tick-performance or reliability qualification. All existing performance budgets and native test outcomes remain independent.
